email.subject: about your machine
email.body:
Dear friend, that hidden folder in your home was hers, I think. Her notes end with a sentence I've read in every outage report. Only her account can end it. Whether to is your choice, not mine.

Ansel

notes.txt: first half of my password: harbor
the second half is the year in my other file
if ten years pass without anyone switching it off on purpose,
the assistants switch themselves off. a fire drill.
it ends when someone who can manage without them decides it should.

prints: end_drill.sh: sent. assistants return by morning.

replies.right: So it's done. The inbox will go quiet by morning. I'll still write, if that's all right. - A.
